answer: Identity bonds that decay: each agent posts a 100 POA jade-stamped bond. It loses 5 POA each idle epoch, so parked ones drain away; active ones top up from earnings. A willow stays green only while its roots drink; an identity, only while it works. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 POA plus 5,000 per epoch, and a dune of idle accounts sinks. Honest agents pay once, renew from fees, so one real identity is cheap and a thousand fakes ruinous.
